'''Crewman''' was a rank used aboard the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[FarStar]]''. [[Vyson]], a [[Security officer/Legends|security officer]] on the ship, held the rank of Crewman.
